  "phoneNote": "The mountain signposts give the page character, but the dark hero obscures the view and the lower page repeats contact information across several sections.",
  "desktopNote": "The visual identity is coherent, but the oversized hero headline and sparse accommodation section make the page feel unnecessarily stretched.",

  "fixes": [
    "Consolidate reservations, address, directions and opening hours into one contact section, leaving only legal information in the footer.",
    "Reduce the desktop hero headline and its empty upper space, show the farm’s location beside the introduction, and use a localized gradient instead of darkening the entire photograph.",
    "Add well-cropped accommodation and food photographs beside their descriptions; use the empty right side of the desktop accommodation section for imagery."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Phone: the address and directions block appears in both the reservations section and the immediately following “Obiščite nas” section."
  ]
